structured_output.summary: The finding was about a missing test, so I added one and left src/ alone. The game already saves the key only when car 0 finishes (src/game.ts:199), but no test checked that. New file tests/game/pine-ridge-player-only.test.ts starts a two-car Hay Loop race with seed 3. It steps the game with no player input (game.step uses NO_INPUT) until racer 1, the bot, has a finishTick, giving up after 10800 ticks. It then asserts that car 0 has not finished, that localStorage has no racer.finished.hay-loop, and that after game.showMenu() the Pine Ridge radio is still aria-disabled with its "Locked" padlock. Red/green: with the verifier's mutation applied temporarily (`racers.some((x) => x.finishTick != null)`), the test fails with "expected '1' to be null". With the real code restored (byte-identical, checked with cmp), it passes. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes: 147 files, 854 tests.
